source: VisitTheUSA.com (Brand USA, the official U.S. tourism site). Its region-to-state map is printed in the global nav flyout on every page: https://www.visittheusa.com/travel-spotlights-midwest-region . Adopted 2026-10-04 because it is the only scheme that is simultaneously official, complete (all 50 states + DC, no orphan), published (copied rather than invented) and simple (6 groups, largest 13). Full research: /home/user/Documents/research/us-region-schemes-proven-2026-10-04.md
why_not_the_others: Census 4 regions are lopsided (South 17, West 13). Literal Census division labels are unreadable to a reader ('East North Central'). KOA is the RV-native alternative with 10 regions, but it leaves Hawaii unassigned and omits DC from its lists, and we are adding both.
disagreements_kept_as_published: Two placements are VisitTheUSA's and are not what Census, BEA, NPS or KOA say: MISSOURI is in Southeast (they all say Midwest) and NORTH and SOUTH DAKOTA are in West (they all say Midwest/Plains). Kept because the brief was to copy a proven high-traffic scheme rather than invent one. Moving any of them is an edit to a `states` list below; then python3 scripts/build-listings.py and build-shell.mjs, and check-regions.py --check will hold the hub to it.
order: Pacific to Northeast reads west-to-east, which is how someone planning a crossing thinks about the map. States are alphabetical inside each region.
